test_title: PYST 224: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 9th Dec,, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The cat / drank the milk / before we / return home.
solution:
The correct answer is "**return home**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **action has already happened**. That is, the cat has already drunk the milk.
 
• It is in the **past tense.** 
 
 
• **Example:** *Jim **sang** well at the concert. *
 
 
 
• So, **"return**" should also be in the **past tense**. But, it is given in the **present tense** in the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should have been, "The cat drank the milk before we **returned home**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Past tense** can be divided into **four types.**
 
• **Simple Past Tense - ***Tim **walked** to the market.*
 
• **Past Continuous Tense - ***Tim **was walking** to the market.*
 
• **Past Perfect Tense - ***Tim **had walked** to the market.*
 
• **Past Perfect Continuous Tense - ***Tim **had been walking** to the market.*
